title: Intro to Throwing With Mary Wuest – Thursday AM
source_quote: Learn the basics of ceramics this spring in a fun 12 week class for beginning students. Adult students will learn in a supportive small class setting with our teaching artist, Mary Wuest. Use the potter's wheel to create beautiful, useful art and learn to decorate, glaze and fire your work. Jul 2 –
